metadata.description: Baseline validation queries for AI agent performance testing (NFR-016)

document_code_queries.description: Queries with specific document codes (BMS-XXX-YYY-###) - expect search_hybrid tool
queries: Find document BMS-SAF-BRK-001
Show me BMS-NET-VLN-042
What is in BMS-FLT-OPS-123?
Search for BMS-TRN-EMG-005
Retrieve BMS-COM-SIG-078
I need BMS-PWR-SUP-019
Look up BMS-DOC-REF-201
Get BMS-MNT-SCH-067
Display BMS-SAF-PRO-099
Open BMS-SYS-CFG-034

procedural_how_to_queries.description: How-to procedural questions - expect ask_bms tool
queries: How do I activate the emergency brake system?
How to configure VLAN settings for train communications?
How do I perform a brake test on Class 395 trains?
How to troubleshoot signal failures?
How do I reset the traction control system?
How to conduct pre-departure safety checks?
How do I report a track defect?
How to calibrate speed sensors?
How do I handle passenger emergencies?
How to perform routine maintenance on doors?

conceptual_what_is_queries.description: Conceptual 'what is' exploratory questions - expect search_semantic tool
queries: What is the emergency brake procedure?
What are VLAN configurations used for?
What is traction control in railway systems?
What are the safety protocols for tunnels?
What is automatic train protection?
What are the requirements for driver certification?
What is regenerative braking?
What are the components of the signaling system?
What is the difference between ATO and ATP?
What are the fire safety requirements?

metadata_queries.description: Author, date, version, department filtering queries - expect search_metadata tool
queries: Who wrote the safety manual?
When was the brake procedure document last updated?
What version is the current operations guide?
Show me all documents from the safety department
What documents were created in 2024?
Who authored document BMS-SAF-BRK-001?
What is the revision history for the maintenance guide?
Show me version 2.0 of the emergency procedures
What documents were updated by John Smith?
List all documents published after January 2024

edge_cases.description: Compound questions, ambiguous queries, out-of-scope - various tool behaviors

queries.query: Who wrote document BMS-SAF-BRK-001 and what changed in version 2.0?
queries.expected_behavior: Agent decomposes into 2 calls: author lookup + version comparison

queries.query: What are the emergency procedures for both Class 395 and Class 465 trains?
queries.expected_behavior: Single search_semantic call with broad query

queries.query: Find documents about brakes and VLAN and safety
queries.expected_behavior: Single search_hybrid call with combined keywords

queries.query: What is the weather forecast for tomorrow?
queries.expected_behavior: Agent responds 'I can only answer questions about BMS railway documentation'

queries.description: Specific document section with explanation request

queries.query: Compare the brake procedures for Class 395 versus Class 465
What changed between version 1.0 and version 3.0 of the safety manual?
Show me the latest version of all emergency procedures
